mapper.update: MERGE INTO POPUP.USER_POPUP_STATUS s USING (SELECT #{userId} AS EMPLOYEE_NO, #{popupId} AS POPUP_ID FROM DUAL) src ON (s.EMPLOYEE_NO = src.EMPLOYEE_NO AND s.POPUP_ID = src.POPUP_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s.POPUP_STATUS = CASE WHEN s.COMPLETED_YN = 'Y' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'CLOSED' END, s.FIRST_DISPLAYED_AT = CASE WHEN #{displayedAt, typeHandler=server.repo.core.mapper.popup.KstTimestampTypeHandler} IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(s.FIRST_DISPLAYED_AT, #{displayedAt, typeHandler=server.repo.core.mapper.popup.KstTimestampTypeHandler}) ELSE s.FIRST_DISPLAYED_AT END, s.LAST_DISPLAYED_AT = COALESCE( #{displayedAt, typeHandler=server.repo.core.mapper.popup.KstTimestampTypeHandler}, s.LAST_DISPLAYED_AT), s.DISPLAY_COUNT = s.DISPLAY_COUNT + CASE WHEN #{displayedAt, typeHandler=server.repo.core.mapper.popup.KstTimestampTypeHandler} IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, s.CLOSED_AT = COALESCE( #{closedAt, typeHandler=server.repo.core.mapper.popup.KstTimestampTypeHandler}, ), s.UPDATED_BY = #{userId}, s.UPDATED_AT = WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( USER_POPUP_STATUS_ID, EMPLOYEE_NO, POPUP_ID, POPUP_STATUS, FIRST_DISPLAYED_AT, LAST_DISPLAYED_AT, DISPLAY_COUNT, CLOSED_AT, COMPLETED_YN, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( POPUP.SEQ_USER_POPUP_STATUS.NEXTVAL, src.EMPLOYEE_NO, src.POPUP_ID, 'CLOSED', #{displayedAt, typeHandler=server.repo.core.mapper.popup.KstTimestampTypeHandler}, #{displayedAt, typeHandler=server.repo.core.mapper.popup.KstTimestampTypeHandler}, CASE WHEN #{displayedAt, typeHandler=server.repo.core.mapper.popup.KstTimestampTypeHandler} IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(#{closedAt, typeHandler=server.repo.core.mapper.popup.KstTimestampTypeHandler}, ), 'N', #{userId}, #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POPUP.APP_USER WHERE EMPLOYEE_NO = #{userId} AND ACTIVE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT s.POPUP_STATUS AS popupStatus, CASE WHEN s.COMPLETED_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completed, FROM_TZ(s.COMPLETED_AT, 'Asia/Seoul') AS completedAt, FROM_TZ(s.HIDDEN_UNTIL_AT, 'Asia/Seoul') AS hiddenUntilAt FROM POPUP.USER_POPUP_STATUS s WHERE s.EMPLOYEE_NO = #{userId} AND s.POPUP_ID = #{popupId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POPUP.WPF_RESULT_RECEIPT WHERE RESULT_ID = #{resultId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POPUP.WPF_RESULT_RECEIPT (RECEIPT_ID, RESULT_ID, EMPLOYEE_NO, POPUP_ID, RESULT_TYPE, RESULT_STATUS, RESULT_CODE) VALUES (POPUP.SEQ_WPF_RESULT_RECEIPT.NEXTVAL, #{resultId}, #{userId}, #{popupId}, #{resultType}, #{resultStatus}, #{resultCode})

INSERT INTO POPUP.API_REQUEST_LOG (API_REQUEST_LOG_ID, CLIENT_REQUEST_ID, EMPLOYEE_NO, POPUP_ID, API_PATH, HTTP_METHOD, CLIENT_IP, REQUEST_RECEIVED_AT, RESPONSE_COMPLETED_AT, ELAPSED_MILLISECONDS, HTTP_STATUS_CODE, SUCCESS_YN, REQUEST_SUMMARY, RESPONSE_SUMMARY, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY) VALUES (POPUP.SEQ_API_REQUEST_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{clientRequestId}, #{userId}, NULL, #{apiPath}, #{httpMethod}, #{clientIp}, #{requestReceivedAt, typeHandler=server.repo.core.mapper.popup.KstTimestampTypeHandler}, , #{elapsedMilliseconds}, #{httpStatusCode}, #{successYn}, #{requestSummary, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{responseSummary, jdbcType=CLOB}, COALESCE(#{userId}, 'WPF'), COALESCE(#{userId}, 'WPF'))
